## Change / 改动

What problem does this solve, and what changes for the user?

解决什么问题，用户会看到什么变化？

## Verification / 验证

Commands run and any manual checks, including platform and client versions where relevant.

执行的检查，以及适用时实际验证的平台与客户端版本。

## Limits / 限制

Any unverified behavior or remaining work. Keep private session data and local settings out of the patch.

尚未验证的行为或剩余工作。不要在补丁中包含私人会话或本地设置。
